description: This source file defines an attribute class `RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterAttribute` used for filtering silos based on specific metadata key-value pairs in Orleans runtime placement strategy.

classes.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterAttribute
classes.description: An attribute to specify that a silo must have particular metadata key-value pairs matching the local silo for placement.

methods.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterAttribute
methods.description: Constructor initializing the attribute with metadata keys and optional order, and setting up the placement filter strategy.
